video_title: Would LeBron Really Go Back to “Miami Heat Boot Camp” at 41?

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James returning to Miami Heat at age 43
quotes.excerpt: He's 43. Does he want somebody taking away his chocolate chip cookies again?

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: I was actually surprised, Channing, when people thought LeBron was going to go back to Miami.

text_blocks.speaker: Allie Clifton
text_blocks.text: He'd have the ball in his hands, right?

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: Yes, but also, you know, he's 43. Does he want somebody taking away his chocolate chip cookies again?

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: The story of Pat Riley taking LeBron's cookies
quotes.excerpt: Pat Riley snatched his cookie and LeBron said, 'No, those cookies are from my chef.'

text_blocks.speaker: Channing Frye
text_blocks.text: The culture is Pat Riley runs everything. The story is LeBron, who takes care of his body, spends a million dollars on his body, when they after a game, he likes his chocolate chip cookies. I guess they had lost a couple games, Pat Riley snatched his cookie and LeBron said, 'No, those cookies are from my chef, in my tupperware, give me my fucking cookies. You ain't taking food off my plate because we won or lost a game.'

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: I'm just joking, everybody before y'all go crazy, we're joking. We're saying that with certain great players, you are allowed a little bit of latitude. In Miami, there was no latitude.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James's power struggle in Miami
quotes.excerpt: There was a slight power struggle. You're not above anybody else.
quotes.quote: I don't think it was in line. It was more of like, there was a slight power struggle. There was a slight power struggle. You're not above anybody else. And even Pat Riley said he was surprised that he left and they were building. Understandable. I think everybody was. He went back to Cleveland, so that was acceptable, we understood. But there was some slight power struggles that were there. Little, minute. I won't speak for LeBron, I won't speak for Pat Riley. The reports coming out were that, look, LeBron went there, learned a lot, it was great, it was like a four-year college experience. He learned so many things and then carried that with him. Now to go back in that and to be like, you have less influence than you had before, and you've had less influence than you had with the Lakers, then you did with Cleveland, the, you know, this is what I would like to do, at the end of your career, you're going back into a boot camp with less influence than you did when you were the MVP.

quotes.speaker: Allie Clifton
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo's reaction to LeBron Cleveland rumors
quotes.excerpt: The way his heart was pounding and freaked out. Actually with the kid that you ignored.
quotes.quote: From a basketball standpoint, I thought you could make sense of it, and I didn't think that it was even in the top three until I saw the reaction last week on Thursday that Giannis had when he thought, he saw a clip on the internet that said LeBron signed with Cleveland. And the way his heart was pounding and freaked out. Actually with the kid that you ignored on the way to the Dick's Sporting Goods stage at Fanatics Fest that went viral for you hurting his feelings, the content creator.
